text:
lucy-dx: Quick report — onboarding flow started failing for fresh installs after we published the exports-map change. New users hitting Next/Vercel Edge and Cloudflare Workers. Symptoms: runtime TypeError (sdk.default is not a function) + editors complaining about missing d.ts.

arjun-sdk: Which sample/version? minimal repro?

lucy-dx: sample/edge-quickstart, @redwood/sdk@3.0.0. Steps: npm i @redwood/sdk@3.0.0; next dev; call /api/complete -> runtime crash. Repro logs attached.

bea-build: I unpacked the tarball — dist/types absent (publish race) and package.json exports narrowed to only import/require. Some packagers (Vercel/Bun) are resolving the require path which yields CJS shape that our samples don't expect. Also deep imports like `@redwood/sdk/lib/parse` are now blocked.

kofi-bundler: Quick note: different bundlers resolve exports differently. Vite/esbuild under certain node versions will pick CJS if conditions don't match or if `browser`/`edge` isn't present. Bun has its own resolver. That explains inconsistent customer reports.

arjun-sdk: Paste of the published package.json snippet from npm pack:
```
{
  "name": "@redwood/sdk",
  "version": "3.0.0",
  "main": "dist/cjs/index.js",
  "module": "dist/esm/index.mjs",
  "types": "dist/types/index.d.ts",
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "import": "dist/esm/index.mjs",
      "require": "dist/cjs/index.js"
    }
  }
}
```

bea-build: Two gaps: (1) types omitted from tarball (fix: add files + fail publish if types missing) (2) exports missing `edge`/`browser`/`default` fallbacks and no subpath exports for helpers used by samples.

lucy-dx: Workaround in samples: pin to 2.x or add bundler alias to `node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/esm`. But that hurts first-time DX.

arjun-sdk: Proposed short-term patch (3.0.1):
- include dist/types and add explicit "files" in package.json
- add `edge` conditional and a `default` fallback in exports (so older resolvers get esm)
- add permissive subpath entries for `./lib/*` and `./auth` to keep samples working
Example exports we plan to ship:
```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "edge": "dist/edge/index.mjs",
    "import": "dist/esm/index.mjs",
    "require": "dist/cjs/index.js",
    "default": "dist/esm/index.mjs"
  },
  "./auth": "dist/auth/index.mjs",
  "./lib/*": "dist/lib/*.mjs"
}
```

kofi-bundler: That'll help for many consumers. Also recommend adding an `engines.node` field to clarify minimum Node version (helps older CI images).

bea-build: I'll harden the publish pipeline: run `npm pack` smoke-test in a clean container that installs the generated tarball and builds our sample with Node {14,16,18} matrix and both esbuild+webpack bundling. Fail publish if any smoke test fails.

arjun-sdk: Runtime mitigation: add a shim that normalizes token provider shapes (sync vs async) so if a CJS build lands unexpectedly, we don't enter an auth retry storm. We'll emit a one-time warning log to prompt users to update.

lucy-dx: Also plan to remove deep imports from our sample apps and add a linter rule blocking deep imports from external packages in onboarding repos. We'll keep permissive subpaths temporarily and remove them in a major bump.

doc-bot: Created issue https://github.com/redwood-repo/sdk/issues/1101 with repro, tarball logs, and proposed patch. Assigned to arjun-sdk + bea-build. Labels: release-blocker, edge, dx.

smoke-ci: CI: onboarding/edge smoke failed on main (import error) — blocking release.

arjun-sdk: I'll open the patch PR this afternoon and include a changelog explaining the exports change + immediate workaround steps for users (webpack/esbuild alias snippet, pin recommendation).

lucy-dx: Thanks — once 3.0.1 is published I'll unpin samples and re-run the onboarding matrix. :pray:
